Every line is [DRAFT, NEEDS REVIEW] and none is final copy. altSource records the Toast item each line came from. THESE DESCRIBE THE DISH, NOT THE PHOTOGRAPH: they were written from the filename plus the catalog by someone who cannot see the images, so composition, angle and what is actually in frame all still need a human eye. Where no catalog item matches, the line says so rather than inventing one.
